gloss: to be flexible; to be adaptable

definitions.gloss: to be flexible; to be adaptable; to be accommodating
definitions.explanation: To be able to adjust or adapt to changing circumstances. Describes a person, system, or approach that can handle things flexibly rather than rigidly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}かない。

⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}いて、⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{要望|ようぼう}→要望：14111_youbou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A small shop is more flexible and will accommodate detailed requests.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (positive: is flexible) or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}かない→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (negative: is inflexible/rigid). The negative form is very common. Can describe people, organizations, rules, and systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く (to be flexible)
- {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}かない (to be inflexible)
- ⟦{融通|ゆうずう}→融通：10914_yuuzuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}かせる→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (to exercise flexibility)
- ⟦{融通|ゆうずう}→融通：10914_yuuzuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (flexible; that can accommodate)
